transcript: Robot: kya kar rahe ho? [What are you doing?] Human: I roti making. Robot: [laughs] roti making nahi, I am making rotis bolna chahiye. [Not roti making, you should say I am making rotis.] Human: kya tu mujhe English sikhaogi? [Will you teach me English?] Robot: bilkul. roz mere saath 15 minute practice karke aap bahut jald farratedar English seekh sakti hain. [Of course. By practicing with me for 15 minutes daily, you can learn fluent English very quickly.] Human: par mere paas fees bharne ke liye paise nahi hain. [But I don't have money to pay the fees.] Robot: fikar mat kijiye. aap sirf ek rupaye se shuru kar sakti hain. [Don't worry. You can start with just one rupee.] Human: wah! toh kaise join karun? [Wow! So how do I join?] Robot: neeche diye gaye install button par click kijiye. SpeakEasy app download kijiye aur apni Vani AI ke saath English practice shuru kijiye. [Click on the install button below. Download the SpeakEasy app and start practicing English with your Vani AI.] Presenter: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: An AI robot corrects a woman's English grammar while she cooks. The robot promotes the SpeakEasy app, offering daily 15-minute practice sessions starting at just 1 rupee. The ad concludes with a call to download the app.
